description: The All in One Framework to Build Undefeatable Scrapers

summary.one_liner: Botasaurus is a Python web scraping framework that provides humane browser and HTTP-request decorators, a driver that aims to pass bot-detection checks, and tooling for turning scrapers into UIs or desktop apps.
summary.what_it_does: Botasaurus offers three decorators (@browser, @request, @task) that wrap scraping functions and handle parallel execution, caching, retries, proxies, and output saving to JSON, Excel, or CSV. The @browser decorator launches a browser through its own "Botasaurus Driver" with a Selenium/Playwright-like API, including helpers such as google_get, human-mode mouse movement, drag and drop, shadow DOM access, iframe handling, and CDP command execution. The @request decorator makes browser-like HTTP requests via a botasaurus-requests library, and soupify turns responses into BeautifulSoup objects. The README also describes a starter template that turns a scraper into a web UI with auto-generated API docs, and a Desktop Extractor path for building cross-platform apps using JavaScript. Async queues, run_async, and monitoring of network responses via CDP are also documented. The README claims bypass of Cloudflare, Datadome, and other bot checks, shown in a video and demo pages that are not verifiable from the text.
use_cases: Scraping websites protected by Cloudflare or other bot detection
Building a scraper with a web UI and REST API for non-technical users
Packaging a scraper as a desktop app for Windows, macOS, or Linux
Running parallel or cached scraping jobs across many URLs
Real-time scrapers such as search or maps result fetchers
Extracting data from PDFs or Excel files into a desktop tool
how_to_run: git clone my-botasaurus-project (starter template for UI scraper)
notable: Humane browser driver with built-in human-mode mouse movement and Cloudflare bypass helpers (bypass_cloudflare=True on google_get)
Decorator-based design where @browser, @request, and @task share options for parallelism, caching, retries, and output
async_queue lets a browser scroll while HTTP requests scrape results concurrently
Starter template turns a scraper function into a web UI with inputs defined in JavaScript and API docs generated per scraper
Desktop app path for packaging scrapers for Mac, Windows, and Linux
caveats: Node.js is required for the browser driver and some features, per the README
Proxies are expensive and slow according to the README; the author recommends using them only when IP blocks occur
Bot-bypass claims are demonstrated in the README's video and demo pages and are not independently verified here
